structure: Part 6 read four files in full: e2e/journeys.fit.spec.js (9 tests in 2 describes: 'notification journeys end to end' runs 5 table-driven walks — cattle by air, poultry by rail, pet cats by air, horse by sea, germinal bovine semen — from Create new to Import notification submitted, through the hub, review and declaration; 'the notification hub' has 4 tests: fresh hub all To do, hub task link returns to hub, review with tasks missing, submitted page guard), e2e/eudpa-691.fit.spec.js (4 tests: A1 Back in the opening run, A2 Arrival details from the hub returns to the hub, B1 and B2 Transit countries saved with none added, in the run and from the hub), and the shared helpers e2e/support/journey.js (base path, urlFor, step helpers, species, addresses, field names) and e2e/support/fixtures.js (records visited pages per test; no journey behaviour). Claims cover the page order each walk asserts, the hub rows, statuses and links, the review sections and content, the declaration copy and error, the submitted page copy and links, and every field and option the shared helpers drive for these tests.

claims.statement: Every Design Release 2.1 journey page is served under the /design-release-2.1 path prefix, a mirror of the root route table.
claims.quote:
// Design Release 2.1 is a mirror mount of the root route table.
const BASE = '/design-release-2.1'

await page.goto(url('/create-notification'))

The origin page shows the draft notification's reference, in the form GBN-<two letters>-<two digits>-<letters and digits>, in a draft strip on journey pages.
claims.note: The pattern is the test's reading of the reference, not a format rule the prototype states.

claims.statement: In the opening run, Save and continue on the origin page goes to What are you importing (/what-are-you-importing).

A region code entered for France (code 75) is shown on the review page as FR-75, so the region code is prefixed with the country code.
claims.quote:
origin: { search: 'Fran', country: 'France', region: 'Yes', code: '75', reference: 'CATTLE-2026-01' },
...
    reviewContains: ['FR-75', 'CATTLE-2026-01',
claims.note: The prefix rule is read from the entered '75' and the shown 'FR-75'.

claims.statement: When the import reason is Internal market, the page asks for the internal market purpose (internalMarketPurpose), with options including Breeding and Companion animal not for resale or rehoming.

When the import reason is Transit, the page asks for the exit border control post (#transit-exit-border-control-post, a select with Holyhead POE - GBHLY) and the destination country (#transit-destination-country, a select with Republic of Ireland).

When the import reason is Temporary admission horses, the page asks for the exit date (#temporary-admission-exit-date, a date picker) and the port of exit (#temporary-admission-port-of-exit, a select with Holyhead POE - GBHLY).
The main import reason page can also take a transhipment destination country (#transhipment-destination-country, a select).
claims.quote: if (transhipmentCountry) await page.locator('#transhipment-destination-country').selectOption(transhipmentCountry)
claims.note: The helper supports it; no test in this part chooses it.

claims.statement: Continue on the review page of a complete notification goes to the declaration page (/declaration), titled 'Declaration - Import notification service - GOV.UK' with the heading 'Declaration'.
claims.quote:
await submitForm(page, 'Continue')
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(urlFor('/declaration'))
    await expect(page).toHaveTitle('Declaration - Import notification service - GOV.UK')
    await expectHeading(page, 'Declaration')

claims.statement: The declaration states 'I am the contact for the authorities and located in the UK.'
claims.quote: I am the contact for the authorities and located in the UK.

claims.statement: The declaration states 'I am complying with the requirements of Regulation (EU) 2017/625 including on animal health and welfare.'
claims.quote: I am complying with the requirements of Regulation (EU) 2017/625 including on animal health and welfare.

claims.statement: The declaration includes the undertaking to meet 'any costs needed for destruction and disposal of consignments, when instructed by the authorities'.
claims.quote: any costs needed for destruction and disposal of consignments, when instructed by the authorities

    await startNotification(page, 'live-animals')
    await page.goto(url('/notification-submitted'))
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(urlFor('/declaration'))

claims.statement: Journey pages offer Save and continue (action continue) and a save and return to overview action (action hub), and the add another action (action add-another) where a page takes several entries.
claims.quote:

const saveAndReturnToOverview = (page) => clickAction(page, 'hub')
claims.note: Save and return to overview is exported but no test in this part uses it; its button text is not asserted.

claims.statement: The tests do not show the hub statuses between To do and Complete, such as a row part-answered or answered then made incomplete by a later change.

claims.statement: The tests do not say what date the declaration page shows after 'Date of declaration:', or how it is formatted.

The tests do not say where Back goes on a page opened from the hub, or where Save and continue goes on pages other than Main import reason, Arrival details and Transit countries when opened from the hub.
The tests do not show the review page's change links, or what the Delete button on the review page does.
